name: Silent Star Symphony
source:
It's been three months since Haoyu and Luca met, and their relationship is blossoming in the winter snow. 

But both their worlds are changing fast. Maybe faster than they can adapt. 

Luca is still running. From the past, the future, the silence. Himself.

Haoyu is finally living as he wants to. Afraid he can't reach the stars himself. 

So maybe they can share the world. Play the symphony together. One meaningful something at a time. 

[From [url=https://pinknarcissus.itch.io/silent-star-symphony]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
浩宇和卢卡相识已经三个月了，他们的感情在冬雪中绽放。

但他们的世界都在快速变化。也许比他们适应的速度更快。

卢卡仍在奔跑。来自过去，未来，沉默。他自己。

浩宇终于活成了自己想要的样子。恐怕他自己无法到达星星。

所以也许他们可以分享这个世界。一起演奏交响乐。一次做一件有意义的事情。

[来自[url=https://pinknarcissus.itch.io/silent-star-symphony]itch.io[/url]]
